rationale: First-order heater with measured hold u~0.33 for y=0.5, K~1.0-1.2, tau~150-200s, lag ~20-30s. Feedforward supplies most steady power so feedback only trims residual; this minimizes energy and windup. PI Kp=0.8 gives loop gain K*Kp~0.9 with crossover ~0.005 rad/s, phase loss from 25s delay only ~7deg, robust. Ti=133s (Ki=0.006) near plant tau for low overshoot. 12s EMA filter cuts 0.005-0.01 rms noise to ~0.003 with negligible lag vs 170s plant. Integral gated to |e|<0.2 and clamped to +-0.25 to prevent warm-up windup yet leave 5x authority over max plausible 0.05 feedforward error. Output clamped 0-0.70 stays below soft 0.85 limit while allowing 0.35 rise in ~120s. Back-calculation anti-windup on saturation.

extra.machine_card: Heater: positive gain, self-draining to room ~0.10-0.16. E2: 0.534->0.157 in 480s at u=0. E1: 0.23->0.49 in 180s at u=0.5 with ~20-30s initial lag. E3: u=0.23 lifts 0.15->~0.355, no large deadzone. E4-E7: u=0.38 settles >0.533, u=0.33 settles 0.505 flat slope 0.0004 after 300s, so hold for 0.5 is ~0.32-0.34, use 0.33. Linear approx y_ss~0.14+1.05*u, K~0.9-1.2. Dominant tau ~150-200s, settling 400-600s. Noise small ~0.005-0.01 rms, p-p 0.013-0.03, half-band is 0.025. Positive response, monotonic, slower slope near equilibrium.
